family: confirmatory H1-H12; Holm (FWER) and Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) reported
rules: no iid binomial CI on overlapping cohorts
exploratory policy search evaluated on held-out paths
legacy: H1-H4 (v1) remain available under /v1/research/hypotheses with their original definitions

hypotheses.claim: Optimal fixed-income allocation responds to signed net flow after conditioning on age
hypotheses.null: d b*/d q = 0 at every key age
hypotheses.estimand: Partial effect d bond_weight*/d q at fixed age, path-bootstrap CI
hypotheses.falsification: CI includes zero at more than half of the pre-specified ages
CI lower bound <= 0.1% or economically immaterial

hypotheses.claim: Bond utility varies with inflation / stock-bond dependence regime
hypotheses.null: bond-sleeve dCE equal across starting regimes
hypotheses.estimand: Difference in paired dCE(60/40 vs 100/0) between regimes

hypotheses.claim: Additional sleeves improve sustainability in some states
hypotheses.null: Shapley CE of every extra sleeve <= 0
hypotheses.falsification: No sleeve with CI lower bound > 0

hypotheses.claim: Classic Permanent Portfolio beats 60/40 in a specified subset of withdrawal and regime states
hypotheses.estimand: Paired dCE, same spending, cells r x start regime
hypotheses.falsification: No cell with CI > 0 after multiple-test control

hypotheses.claim: Cash-flow-aware rebalancing improves net CE vs calendar
Bond duration affects outcomes beyond total bond share
hypotheses.null: Equal outcomes across duration at equal bond weight
hypotheses.estimand: CE difference long vs short duration

hypotheses.claim: Point-in-time macro conditioning improves OOS utility
hypotheses.estimand: Holdout dCE on disjoint test paths; chronological walk-forward

hypotheses.claim: Survival-optimal and CE-optimal allocations diverge in some region
hypotheses.estimand: Max allocation distance over r in [3%,7%]

hypotheses.claim: Equity-bond co-loss probability explains nonlinear bond value
hypotheses.null: bond value independent of co-loss regime

hypotheses.claim: A cash/TIPS buffer reduces early-retirement shortfall
hypotheses.estimand: Paired difference in early shortfall and CE after cash drag
hypotheses.falsification: No improvement in early shortfall or net welfare loss

hypotheses.claim: Thresholds are stable enough to communicate
hypotheses.null: Bootstrap width of b_min > 10pp or model agreement < 80%
hypotheses.estimand: Confidence-set width of b_min and generator sign agreement
hypotheses.falsification: Wide/unstable thresholds -> publish identified ranges only
